title: 2553 item 6: the TIN branch code prints three compartments, BIR's own runtime declares five

subject.description: The fourth (branch-code) group of the item-6 TIN comb chain on page 1. The chain prints four boxes at x 57.84-91.92 / 96.48-129.84 / 134.16-167.52 / 172.08-205.44, all y 189.36-208.80, each white-filled and stroked 0.72pt black, separated by three solid dashes filled rgb(1, 0.8, 0.6) at x 91.68-96.72 / 129.60-134.40 / 167.28-172.32 over the same y band. The item caption is the glyph '6' at x 22.32-26.72 and 'TIN' at x 36.48-49.37, y 188.40-197.52, which is the same item number rules/forms/2553-v1999/fields.json records for all four fields. After the 2026-08-17 sitting the whole chain (not only this box) is reflowed to even 3-3-3-5 inside the original outer span; this printed box remains the PDF identity of the branch group.

match.strategy: the single element carrying data-field-kind="comb" whose emitted box equals printed_box_pt. At HEAD 98ca03c3 the emitted box is left 172.20pt width 33.24pt, so its right edge falls on the printed right edge 205.44 exactly and its left edge sits 0.12pt inside the printed left edge 172.08 -- within the tolerance below, and recorded here rather than rounded away.

subject.cell_id_hint: p1c24 at HEAD 98ca03c3 — NON-AUTHORITATIVE. Cell ids are quantised bounding boxes (lattice.geometry_subject_key) and renumber on any geometry change; 42 of 146 cited ids in the findings ledger are already dead (PLAN.md risk R2). If the hint and printed_box_pt disagree, printed_box_pt wins and the applier aborts. The applier binds to the batch by the comb element's exact bytes (946 bytes at HEAD 98ca03c3, occurring once in forms/extra/2553-1999/index.html), not by the id: a later batch that emits it differently makes the applier refuse rather than guess. C01 has already been through exactly that refusal once, so this record was anchored against 98ca03c3 from the start and carries no anchor from an earlier batch.

layout_policy.writing_box: outer TIN strip unchanged 57.84-205.44 pt; the four groups and three separators are reflowed inside it so every digit cell is the same width (3-3-3-5). The official printed boxes are knocked out with a white rectangle of that same outer span.
layout_policy.division: separators keep their printed widths (sum 14.12pt) and move with the groups; digit cells equal-split the remaining 133.48pt into 14: [9.53, 9.54, 9.53, 9.54, 9.53, 9.54, 9.53, 9.53, 9.54, 9.53, 9.54, 9.53, 9.54, 9.53]
layout_policy.slot_inset: none — even digit-cell width across the whole strip is the rule; re-applying per-group 0.36pt insets would squeeze the edges of each group and make the last five cells look different from the first nine
layout_policy.per_slot_input: TIN1/2/3: one editable maxlength-1 input per cell. Branch: five editable maxlength-1 inputs, each blank — no value attribute, no readonly, no tabindex override. The branch code is a value the filer supplies on this sheet.
layout_policy.note: Rounding is fixed here so the applier's output is byte-deterministic and re-computable by hand from the box width and the batch's two insets alone: round(i * 33.24 / 5, 2), then clamp the first left to 0.48 and the last right to 32.88.
layout_policy.branch_lock: NOT locked — the official branch box prints no 000 and no ink of any kind inside it. A locked 00000 here would declare the head office on a form whose filer must name a real branch, so the five cells stay editable. Widening 3 (or 4) compartments to 5 is the whole change; nothing is pre-filled.
layout_policy.chrome: each digit group: one outer 0.72pt frame, white knockout inside. Interior ticks are short bottom hairs (~33% of slot height), matching the official charbox (2550M month v172), not a full-height wall on every digit. Separators: dedicated SVG fill + 0.72pt black frame, no input, not in tab order.

reason: BIR's July-1999 artwork for 2553 is CORRECT and OUT OF DATE. It prints three compartments for the TIN branch code and, unlike 2550M, pre-prints nothing in them. BIR's own eBIRForms client, whose runtime this repository has harvested, declares that same field with max_length 5. No rule can derive 'BIR widened this field after 1999' from 1999 ink, which is precisely why this is a stage-2 correction and not a stage-1 producer bug (ARCHITECTURE.md, 'What belongs in which stage').

filing_safety.harm: The return is filed against the wrong branch. A TIN's branch code identifies the establishment the return belongs to; if it cannot be entered, the percentage-tax return lands on the head office and the branch that incurred the liability files nothing.
filing_safety.who_is_affected: Every 2553 filer whose branch code is not three digits, i.e. any registered branch numbered above 999 (four or five digits). They have no way to enter it on today's form at all.
filing_safety.today: Three blank compartments — 2553 pre-prints no default, so the filer sees three empty boxes and can enter at most three characters.
filing_safety.after: Five compartments over the same printed box; a four- or five-digit branch code becomes enterable, and the emitted value can carry the five characters BIR's own client accepts for frm2553:txtBranchCode.

checks_that_must_report_it.expected_finding: the branch comb appears as an offender. The check compares the layout's slot count against the compartments it recovers from the source's own paint stream and, on disagreement, records failure kind `layout-printed-mismatch` (audit.py:8427 and audit.py:8466 in this checkout; the check itself is check_comb_slots_match_printed at audit.py:7969); where the corrected HTML carries five slots against a layout that carries three, it records `invalid-emission` instead (audit.py:8628). Which of the two fires depends on whether the applier also rewrites the copied layout — either is acceptable, silence is not.

the five corrected compartments span page x 172.68-178.85 / 178.85-185.50 / 185.50-192.14 / 192.14-198.79 / 198.79-205.08 while the printed dividers stand at x 182.88 and 194.16, so the second and fourth inputs each contain a printed divider — which is exactly what this assertion walks every input to find (check_inputs_span_no_printed_divider at audit.py:9368). The three-compartment emission it replaces had its boundaries ON those dividers and offended nothing, so this check gains offenders on 2553 where it had none, and on no other form.
